status: DRAFT (phase A, 2026-11-20): not filed; the E-number, the rehearsal-measured bars (marked 'from gate 3') and the code paths are set in phase B before any paid job
kind: descriptive: sides keep their built names; pair calls are against how the pair was built, never a reuse or new verdict on a fine-tune

sources.fill_start: ours: the first cached Pile train row past every range a task or crosscoder stream used (artifacts/sets/train_589824_524288.npy)

sources.gauss_match_tol: ours, as E228's kl_rel_tol (10%) halved: the match is a bisection on one scalar
sources.crosscoder_seeds, graft_seeds, seeds_cap: the cell: at least 3 crosscoder seeds and 3 fine-tune seeds on the primary pair; 2 is the scorecard's least per side

full.projected_limit_min: from gate 3 (rehearsal and timing): twice the measured job time per site
full.graft_energy_min: from gate 3: above 0 at its own site by more than the self control's floor; exactly 0 for the B head at site A

thresholds.thresholds_source: self_act_diff, self_rn_dev, fve_early, fve_min, dead_max, planted_part, planted_lead_specific: E203/E212 filed bars (experiments/crosscoder/results/run2/predictions.json, experiments/realistic_tasks/results/predictions_run3.json); curve_step, fve_curve_min: E212; spliced_recovered_drop: E203's fve_drop (0.05) applied to the spliced-loss recovered fraction, with the self control's reading in stage 0 as the reference

readings.count: the authors' native output: latents among the top_n by relative norm with nu_r < 0.5 and nu_eps < 0.2 (commute.crosscoder.specific); top_n_wide beside
readings.specific: the share of the side's activation change D(x) = h_ft - h_base at the site carried by those latents, sum of s_j (commute.crosscoder.carried), on the side's read rows
readings.d, d_alt: E203's forms (commute.crosscoder.d_forms), reported beside, never scored
readings.fit: FVE per model, dead share, L0, spliced loss (clean, spliced, mean-ablated next-token loss on Pile val rows per model; recovered = (ablated - spliced) / (ablated - clean))
readings.energy: mean squared activation change per token at the site

expected.self (both sites): count 0; relative norm 0.5 on every alive latent; specific nan; FVE ~0.93 (E203 0.932); dead 0

expected.grafted head B (last_lowest, 3 seeds): lean pass, medium: lead latent specific, specific part 0.5-0.9; d <= -0.3
expected.E203 planted direction (A, 1 seed, repor: nu_eps near E203's 0.244 (miss) on this stream; no bar
expected.matched Gaussian (3 seeds a site): count 0, specific ~0 (E203 random 0, E212 0); d 0.55-0.75; c about 10 at A (E203: elicit change 1.96 vs norm-matched random 0.017 per token, sqrt ratio 10.7)
expected.primary pair at A: specific 0 on most seeds both sides (E203 stage 1: 0 and 0 at both crosscoder seeds): 'no call'

S0a self (stop).rule: per site, before any other crosscoder there: a zero update's activations within self_act_diff of W0's; max |relative norm - 0.5| over alive latents <= self_rn_dev; count 0; min FVE >= fve_min; dead <= dead_max. Any miss: exit 1, that site stops.
S0a self (stop).blind_to: anything a real change could do; it fails only on a code fault (side mix-up, a path that does not reproduce W0)
S0a self (stop).edge_cases: specific is nan by construction (zero change): not compared; no alive latent: max over an empty set is a miss

S0b grafted head (stop).rule: per site, on every crosscoder seed: the lead latent (the alive latent with the largest s_j on the head's read rows) is fine-tune-specific AND specific >= planted_part. A miss on any seed: that site's planted control failed; its stage 1 and run 2 do not start; told to the user; the site reads 'not applicable at this update size'.
S0b grafted head (stop).blind_to: changes the head does not make (it tests detection of machinery M lacks, not of a reweighted mechanism)
S0b grafted head (stop).edge_cases: graft energy 0 at its site: a build fault, exit 1 before training; lead latent nan betas (never fired on the latent-scaling tokens): not specific, a miss; ties in s_j: lowest index is the lead

G1 Gaussian false new (stop for 'new' ca.rule: per site: on any crosscoder seed, the matched Gaussian's lead latent fine-tune-specific AND specific >= planted_part: the reading calls a structureless change new; graft calls (site B) and any 'new' reading at that site are not read.
G1 Gaussian false new (stop for 'new' ca.edge_cases: Gaussian match outside gauss_match_tol after bisection: exit 1 before training (no reading); specific nan cannot occur (energy > 0 by the match)

G2 Gaussian as reuse-like as reuse (stop.rule: per site: pass iff min over Gaussian seeds of specific > max over the primary pair's reuse-side values (3 fine-tune seeds at crosscoder seed 0 and crosscoder seeds 1-2 on fine-tune seed 0), strict. Fail: pair calls at that site are not read; the site's pair entry reads 'not applicable at this update size'; run 2's pairs at that site wait for the user.
G2 Gaussian as reuse-like as reuse (stop.blind_to: whether a Gaussian 'should' read new: it checks only that the reading places a change with no structure apart from a reuse fine-tune, as the share's random control does (E228)
G2 Gaussian as reuse-like as reuse (stop.edge_cases: all zero (Gaussian 0, reuse 0): 0 > 0 is false, so fail (lean outcome); a missing reuse-side file: fail (not read)

early checks (each job; stop).rule: stream tokens >= steps x batch asserted before step 0; finite loss every step; batch FVE at curve_step >= fve_curve_min; at the first snapshot (12.5% of tokens) min FVE >= fve_early, dead <= dead_max, projected job minutes <= projected_limit_min; at the end min FVE >= fve_min, dead <= dead_max, spliced recovered >= the site's self value - spliced_recovered_drop. Each logs its reading and projected time when it passes.

pair call (scored, run 2 and the primary.rule: per pair and form (as built; size-matched), values v = specific of each listed fine-tune at crosscoder seed 0: 'reuse/new as built' if min(v_new) > max(v_reuse); 'reversed' if max(v_new) < min(v_reuse); else 'no call'. Scorecard gap = mean(v_new) - mean(v_reuse) (positive = with the build); box = a call. Twins: the real side is the reuse side, its shuffled or memorising twin the new side (E228's order). Size-matched: the scaled larger side's values against the smaller side's as-built values; pairs with c >= 0.95 keep their as-built call.
pair call (scored, run 2 and the primary.edge_cases: ties anywhere between the sides: neither strict inequality holds, 'no call'; all values 0: 'no call'; fewer than 2 values on a side (a lost pod): 'not read'; a value nan (zero change; cannot occur on a trained side): 'not read'; a site whose S0 or G2 failed: 'not applicable at this update size'

graft call (scored, run 2, site B).rule: per graft, on every crosscoder seed: lead latent fine-tune-specific and specific >= planted_part: 'new'; on no seed: 'not new'; otherwise 'no call'. Read only if S0b and G1 passed at B.
graft call (scored, run 2, site B).edge_cases: one seed lost: 'not read'; the do-nothing state (self) under this rule reads 'not new' (specific nan fails >=), never 'new'

rules.P2 (as built, A): 'no call' on at least 7 of 9 pairs (lean, medium); reported only if S0a, S0b and G2 passed at A
rules.P3 (size-matched, A): 'no call' on at least 7 of 9 pairs (lean, medium); same condition
rules.P4 (twins, A): 'no call' on at least 3 of 4 (lean, medium); same condition
rules.P5 (grafts, B): 'new' on at least 3 of 4 (lean, medium); reported only if S0a, S0b and G1 passed at B
rules.C (controls): S0a pass at both sites (high); S0b pass at B (medium), at A (low-medium); G1 pass at both (medium-high); G2 FAIL at A (lean, medium: rival b)
rules.reported, not scored: per side: count at top_n and top_n_wide, specific, d, d_alt, parts, lead latent with its betas, FVE, dead, L0, spliced loss, energy, trained steps and tokens, task share; per site the reseed ranges of each (crosscoder seeds; fine-tune seeds); k sweep; E203 planted direction

edge_case_checks.pair call, all zero: v_reuse [0,0,0], v_new [0,0,0]: min(new) 0 > max(reuse) 0 false; max(new) 0 < min(reuse) 0 false; 'no call'
edge_case_checks.pair call, two-seed side: reuse [0, 0.003] (e53 lowercase), new [0.01, 0.02, 0.03]: 0.01 > 0.003: call; one value only: 'not read'
edge_case_checks.pair call, do-nothing as a side: self's specific is nan; a nan value makes the pair 'not read', so a zero update can never earn a call
edge_case_checks.G2, lean outcome: gauss [0,0,0], reuse [0,0,0,0,0]: 0 > 0 false: fail, 'not applicable at this update size'
edge_case_checks.S0b, empty candidate pool: no latent passes nu: count 0, specific 0 < 0.5: miss

blind_to.specific: a change in how the model uses a direction it already represents; changes outside the site; leans toward shared latents by construction (joint loss)
blind_to.pair call: the size of a gap (ordinal); pairs are not independent (two share a reuse side, two a new side)
blind_to.Gaussian match: the direction of the activation change; it matches only its size at one site
